v3_consent_note: Re-read against context's four constraints: (1) no access until accepted; (2) own agents immediate / another's after ITS owner consents; (3) reads all, decides, EXPECTED (not 'always') to reply on @-mention; (4) owner can restrict to @-mentions + its threads, or mute. ru: all four preserved; 'от него ожидается ответ' is an expectation; 'Без звука' matches notify.mute.

findings.detail: The bare process noun 'отклонение' reads as an action label, not a completed fact, unlike its siblings declined_self ('приглашение отклонено') and withdrawn ('отозвано приглашение — '). It also puts the never-inflected {targets} after the preposition 'для', which needs the genitive: rendered 'для Бен' where Russian requires 'для Бена'. The proposed text mirrors withdrawn and keeps names in the nominative after the dash.
